basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college graduate navigating the world of higher education applications. Originally from Colorado, I'm passionate about trail running and the great outdoors. I work as a part-time environmental consultant and often spend weekends exploring new trails or volunteering for environmental causes. I usually hop on Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekends when I'm relaxing at home. Single and enjoying the journey!

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Environmental Science and a strong interest in sustainable practices. I learned a lot through my coursework and internships, as well as through self-study and participating in online forums related to environmental conservation.
